A '''red giant''' was a [[Star/Legends|star]] that had progressed past the main sequence. It was smaller than a [[Red supergiant/Legends|red supergiant]]. [[Sokor/Legends|Sokor]] was a [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Giant star|giant]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
